ei.subject: 6월_2022 고2 모의고사
ei.lesson: 32번 — The Slice of Reality We See

fullPassage: Color is an interpretation of wavelengths, one that only exists internally. And it gets stranger, because the wavelengths we’re talking about involve only what we call “visible light”, a spectrum of wavelengths that runs from red to violet. But visible light constitutes only a tiny fraction of the electromagnetic spectrum — less than one ten-trillionth of it. All the rest of the spectrum—including radio waves, microwaves, X-rays, gamma rays, cell phone conversations, wi-fi, and so on — all of this is flowing through us right now, and we’re completely unaware of it. This is because we don’t have any specialized biological receptors to pick up on these signals from other parts of the spectrum. The slice of reality that we can see is limited by our biology.

questions.passage: Color is an interpretation of wavelengths, one that only exists (A)[internally / externally]. And it gets stranger, because the wavelengths we’re talking about involve only what we call “visible light”, a spectrum of wavelengths that runs from red to violet. But visible light constitutes only a (B)[tiny / enormous] fraction of the electromagnetic spectrum — less than one ten-trillionth of it. All the rest of the spectrum—including radio waves, microwaves, X-rays, gamma rays, cell phone conversations, wi-fi, and so on — all of this is flowing through us right now, and we’re completely (C)[conscious / unaware] of it. This is because we don’t have any specialized biological receptors to pick up on these signals from other parts of the spectrum. The slice of reality that we can see is limited by our biology.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① internally — tiny — unaware: 색은 우리 내부(internally)에만 존재하고, 가시광선은 전체의 아주 작은(tiny) 부분이며, 우리는 나머지를 인식하지 못한다(unaware)는 맥락에 부합 ←정답
❌ ② externally: 색이 외부(externally)에 존재한다면 '내부에서만 존재한다'는 글과 모순
❌ ③ enormous: '거대한(enormous) 부분'은 'only(~에 불과한)'와 모순되어 부적절
❌ ④ conscious: 우리가 그것을 의식한다(conscious)면 '완전히 인식하지 못한다(unaware)'는 맥락과 모순
det.tip: exists internally(내부에 존재) / a tiny fraction(아주 작은 부분) / completely unaware(완전히 인식 못함)

questions.passage: Color is an interpretation of wavelengths, one that only exists internally. And it gets (A)[stranger / simpler], because the wavelengths we’re talking about involve only what we call “visible light”, a spectrum of wavelengths that runs from red to violet. But visible light (B)[constitutes / exceeds] only a tiny fraction of the electromagnetic spectrum — less than one ten-trillionth of it. All the rest of the spectrum—including radio waves, microwaves, X-rays, gamma rays, cell phone conversations, wi-fi, and so on — all of this is flowing through us right now, and we’re completely unaware of it. This is because we don’t have any (C)[ordinary / specialized] biological receptors to pick up on these signals from other parts of the spectrum. The slice of reality that we can see is limited by our biology.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① simpler: 뒤에서 놀라운 사실이 이어지므로 '더 단순해진다(simpler)'는 흐름과 반대
✅ ② stranger — constitutes — specialized: 이야기가 더 이상해지고(stranger), 가시광선이 극히 일부를 차지하며(constitutes), 우리에게 전용(specialized) 수용기가 없다는 맥락에 부합 ←정답
❌ ③ exceeds: 'only a tiny fraction(아주 작은 부분에 불과)'과 '초과하다(exceeds)'는 모순
❌ ④ ordinary: '평범한(ordinary) 수용기'는 특정 신호를 못 잡는 이유로서 '특화된'이라는 원문과 어긋남
det.tip: gets stranger(더 이상해지다) / constitutes a fraction(일부를 차지하다) / specialized receptors(전용 수용기)

questions.passage: Color is an (A)[interpretation / reproduction] of wavelengths, one that only exists internally. And it gets stranger, because the wavelengths we’re talking about (B)[involve / exclude] only what we call “visible light”, a spectrum of wavelengths that runs from red to violet. But visible light constitutes only a tiny fraction of the electromagnetic spectrum — less than one ten-trillionth of it. All the rest of the spectrum—including radio waves, microwaves, X-rays, gamma rays, cell phone conversations, wi-fi, and so on — all of this is flowing through us right now, and we’re completely unaware of it. This is because we don’t have any specialized biological receptors to pick up on these signals from other parts of the spectrum. The slice of reality that we can see is (C)[expanded / limited] by our biology.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① reproduction: 색은 파장의 '복제(reproduction)'가 아니라 내부의 '해석'이므로 부적절
❌ ② exclude: 파장이 가시광선을 '포함한다(involve)'는 맥락이라 '배제하다(exclude)'는 반대
❌ ③ expanded: 우리가 보는 현실이 '확장된다(expanded)'면 생물학적 한계로 좁아진다는 결론과 모순
✅ ④ interpretation — involve — limited: 색은 파장의 해석(interpretation)이고, 파장이 가시광선을 포함하며(involve), 현실은 생물학에 의해 제한된다(limited)는 맥락에 부합 ←정답
det.tip: an interpretation of wavelengths(파장의 해석) / involve visible light(가시광선을 포함) / limited by biology(생물학에 제한됨)

All the rest of the spectrum—including radio waves, microwaves, X-rays, gamma rays, cell phone conversations, wi-fi, and so on — all of this is ③<u>trapped</u> through us right now, and we’re completely unaware of it. This is because we don’t have any ④<u>specialized</u> biological receptors to pick up on these signals from other parts of the spectrum. questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 나머지 스펙트럼이 우리를 통과해 '흐른다(flowing)'는 맥락. trapped(갇힌)로 바꾸면 부적절
det.analysis:
❌ ① interpretation — 원문 일치. 색은 파장의 해석(interpretation)이라는 맥락에 적절
❌ ② constitutes — 원문 일치. 가시광선이 일부를 차지한다(constitutes)는 맥락에 적절
✅ ③ trapped — 원문은 flowing. 이 모든 것이 우리 안에 '갇혀 있다(trapped)'는 것은 '우리를 통과해 흐른다'는 원문과 모순 ←정답
❌ ④ specialized — 원문 일치. 전용(specialized) 수용기가 없다는 맥락에 적절
det.tip: all of this is flowing through us — 이 모든 것이 우리를 통과해 흐른다(flowing)

❌ ④ (A) 달리다 — (B) 흐르다: (B)의 runs는 물이 '흐르다'가 아니라 범위가 '뻗어 있다'는 뜻

questions.passage: Color is an interpretation of wavelengths, one that only exists internally. And it gets stranger, because the wavelengths we’re talking about involve only what we call “visible light”, a spectrum of wavelengths that runs from red to violet. But visible light constitutes only a tiny fraction of the electromagnetic spectrum — less than one ten-trillionth of it. All the rest of the spectrum—including radio waves, microwaves, X-rays, gamma rays, cell phone conversations, wi-fi, and so on — all of this is flowing through us right now, and we’re completely unaware of it. This is because we don’t have any specialized biological receptors to __________ from other parts of the spectrum. The slice of reality that we can see is limited by our biology.
